guide: Open Start and type your center name, your cash floor, the days that set each step of the reminder ladder and your card fee in the yellow cells.
Fill Families: one row per family with the billing cycle, pay method, autopay, how they usually pay and any government share.
Type each invoice on Invoices and each payment on Payments. The family share, open balance, days overdue and aging band fill in.
Read Aging by Family and Overdue Families every week: they show who owes what and who to act on first. Reminder Schedule lists the 20 oldest overdue invoices with the next step.
Write every payment promise on Promises and mark it kept or broken; Payment Plans and Plan Instalments hold the plans you agree.
Type each government childcare payment on Government Payments; Government Reconciliation shows expected against received by month and the family share still owed.
Keep Deposits, Cash by Month, Bills, Expenses, Payroll and Tax Set-aside up to date: they feed the Cash Forecast 13 Weeks and the bill, payroll and tax tools.
Read Collections and Autopay for the collection rate and the autopay effect by month.

Use the 18 tools for aging, autopay, government payments, the 13-week forecast, plans, the reminder ladder, promises, risk, write-offs, the cash floor, bills, deposits, tax, payment mix, chasing time, payroll dates and the collection rate.
Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the Payments, Balances and Cash Dashboard and Charts every week.

listing.title: Childcare Center Payments, Balances and Cash Excel Template: A/R Aging, Reminder Ladder, 13-Week Cash Forecast, Autopay
listing.headline: Collect tuition on time and see your cash 13 weeks ahead
listing.description:
Chase tuition and watch your cash in one Excel workbook for a home daycare or childcare center. Built for an owner-director or the assistant director who does the billing. Invoices and payments sit on two sheets; the open balance, days overdue and aging band of each invoice fill in. Aging by Family groups what is owed into 0-30, 31-60, 61-90 and 90+ days past due, shows days outstanding and names the next step for each family: friendly reminder, call, payment plan or notice to pause care.

Promises record whether each family kept its word; Late Payer Risk Ranking scores every family so you call the three at risk first; the Write-off Decision tool weighs the chance of payment against the cost of chasing. Government Payments and Government Reconciliation compare what a government childcare payment should have paid with what arrived, month by month, with the family share still owed. Cash by Month, Bills, Payroll, Expenses and Tax Set-aside feed a 13-week cash forecast built from your own history, with a Base, Best and Worst case and an if-families-leave test against your cash floor.

18 tools answer one weekly question each, with a verdict and a what-if row. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages to families, the assistant director, the owner, the accountant and suppliers. Children's data is names, dates and status only.

This is part five of the Home Daycare and Childcare Center suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. It helps you keep track of payments and cash; it does not promise results, and tax figures are estimates to confirm with your adviser.
features: A/R aging of balances by family: 0-30, 31-60, 61-90 and 90+ days
